pr_title: fix(ivy): support @SkipSelf while injecting special DI tokens
pr_body:
Currently Ivy doesn't support adding `@SkipSelf` for some of the special DI tokens (e.g. `Injector`, `ViewContainerRef`, `ElementRef`, `ChangeDetectorRef`). These changes add support for `@SkipSelf` flag and align the behavior with View Engine.

Closes #34066.
Closes #34819.

## PR Type
What kind of change does this PR introduce?

- [x] Bugfix


## Does this PR introduce a breaking change?

- [ ] Yes
- [x] No

issue_context.title: In Ivy, SkipSelf() is not accessing the parent's ViewContainerRef, ElementRef, etc
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by Angular Ivy ### Description Before Ivy, I was able to access the `ViewContainerRef`, `ElementRef`, etc of the parent directive using the `@SkipSelf` decorator in the child directive. With Ivy integrated in my project, it's no longer skipping its own injections and accessing the ones in its parent. For example, I have the following code: In app.component.ts ```ts @Directive({ selector: '[parentDirective]' }) export class ParentDirective { constructor(private vc: ViewContainerRef){ console.log(vc.element); } } @Directive({ selector: '[childDirective]' }) export class ChildDirective { constructor(@SkipSelf() private vc: ViewContainerRef){ console.log(vc.element); } } ``` in app.component.html ```html
parent child
``` These two directive classes should log the same ViewContainerRef element. However, with Ivy, you can see that's no longer the case. Here is the [reproduction](https://ivy.ng-run.com/edit/xMfu7xoF1t4b8hFvoU9N?open=app%2Fapp.component.html). This reproduction is made in Angular Ivy 8.1.0-next.3. But I also see this behavior in my project that's on "@angular/core": "9.0.0-rc.3", ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction [Minimal Reproduction](https://ivy.ng-run.com/edit/xMfu7xoF1t4b8hFvoU9N?open=app%2Fapp.component.html) ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:** 


"@angular/core": "9.0.0-rc.3",
comments: Note: When trying to fix this, we realized that it's non-trivial because of the way Ivy is architected. We should consider whether this is actually a feature we want long-term due to the design / performance cost.

@kara - RE "whether this is actually a feature we want long-term due to the design / performance cost" - Please see my comments on #39475

In short, [HostBindings not updated by detectChanges() in OnPush component](22560) (or detached components) is a real problem, and the workaround for that requires accessing the parent view's ChangeDetector. 

Personally I think the HostBindings update design is a root problem (it should be possible to update classes tied to property values without jumping through hoops or understanding things like "hostbindings aren't updated by a view's detectChanges()") - I don't know how many other common use-cases there are requiring core parameter types from the node's parent, but my guess is that if that design were fixed, the need for this would be dramatically reduced.

Also, if injectflags are not supported, there should be a compiler or runtime error.
FYI, this issue is resolved by #39464 and the fix will be available in v11.0.0. Thank you.
